The robot on timsrobot.com now moves. I added a new mod, **Living Robot**:

- **Eyes follow your mouse.** They slide up to about 6 px toward the pointer, and their glow moves with them.
- **It blinks** every 2.5–6 seconds, and sometimes blinks twice.
- **Clicking it makes it hop.** It squashes, jumps about 38 px, lands, and bounces a little. It also blinks as it jumps. You can click again during a hop and it starts a new one.

**What I checked after a reload:**
- With a pretend mouse in the top-left corner, the eyes shifted up and to the left. You can see it in the screenshot.
- In the middle of a click, the robot was 37 px up.
- It blinked 6 times in 8 seconds. That's a bit more than usual because of the random double blinks.
- There were no errors.

I tested with simulated mouse moves and clicks, so give it a real wiggle to see how it feels.

The robot now has two little legs and wanders around the page on his own. I added this to the same **Living Robot** mod.

- **Walking:** He picks a random spot in the part of the page you can see and walks there. His legs swing in turn, and he waddles a little as he goes. Then he rests for 1.5–5 seconds and sets off again. About one walk in four, he goes back to his home spot above the title.
- **Looking:** While he walks, he looks where he's going. When you move the mouse, his eyes follow it again.
- **Clicking:** He stops walking while your pointer is over him, so he's easy to click. Clicking still makes him hop.
- He stays inside the visible page, walks over the text, and never adds a scrollbar.

**What I checked after a reload:**
- He set off on his own within a few seconds and walked at a steady pace, about 75 px a second.
- The screenshot shows him mid-stride up in the top-left corner with his legs showing.
- When I clicked him, he hopped, then went back to walking.
- The mod threw no errors, and the page width stayed at 1280 px.

The legs didn't show on my first try because of an SVG drawing quirk, so I made them a solid green.

**Two things I didn't check:**
- I only tried it at the page's current size, which fits in one screen.
- If you scroll, he picks places in the new view on his next walk, but he doesn't follow you while you scroll.

To undo it, switch off **Living Robot** in the side panel, or ask me to. That also turns off the eye-following, blinking and hopping.
